title: Director of Engineering (Staff/Distinguished)
description: Staff/Distinguished Engineer - IC Role - Up to £150,000 base + benefits - Once a month in London The title for this role would be Staff Engineer. This role is perfect for someone who is or has been a CTO/Head of Engineering/Director of Engineering etc, or a well-established Staff Engineer who wants to be a true IC and one of the most senior engineers in the company. You'd be working for a VC-backed SaaS scale-up that has received £25 million in funding. The team is roughly 15 engineers, with a total headcount of around 60. They were founded in 2020 but already have 600+ paying, established global companies who have signed long-term deals to use their software, and £1 billion has already been processed through their system. Rather than simply storing information and following rules, the software increasingly uses AI to interpret data and help companies make smarter decisions. They've invested substantial engineering and product effort using models from OpenAI and Anthropic. There are no limits on tokens or any red tape here. At this level, you'll be trusted and well-equipped to scale the platform and increase production velocity. This role will give you significant ownership of the platform. You'll be trusted to build products and ship them, and have a strong say in how the architecture is designed and built. Their main stack is Python, JavaScript and AWS, but your stack is not a major deciding factor. As they are fully agentic, they want someone who's got their finger on the pulse with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc., but also has the battle scars of an experienced engineer to help maintain engineering fundamentals and architecture. They're London-based and typically go into the office once a month. Their team is spread out across the UK. This is a really good role for someone who wants to be an IC and work with all the latest and greatest tech, all whilst working on something that is real, not just a spin-up idea that was made yesterday. If you don't have an up to date CV we can cross that bridge later. You can easy apply for the role by just apply via your Linkedin. Or drop me a message on here.
